title: spec(ui): drop the `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]` marker on `object-grid`'s `keyboardNavigation` once objectui#11068's reader lands
body:
Restart-when: objectui#11068's keyboard-navigation build is merged on objectui `main` (it lands as an ordinary PR after objectui#11531, the 17.6.0 bump).

Filed by the director seat, summon #32 (`session_016tKoy8NJa35Yih1FdzrVmn`), from the objectui#11068 build dev's out-of-scope finding 1. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is wrong once the build lands

`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` on `main`, the `object-grid` row of `ComponentPropsMap`:
- the member's describe is `'[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced] … No renderer reads it yet: it is declared ahead of the grid's keyboard-navigation build, so authoring it changes nothing today'`;
- its source comment says "When the BUILD lands and the grid reads it, drop the marker in the same change";
- the row docblock (about `:3858`) says `keyboardNavigation` "has NO read point".

The build is objectui's, so the marker cannot move in the same change. After the build lands, the published describe tells authors, AI authors included, that a live key is inert. That is a declared/enforced mismatch in the inverse direction.

## The build that makes it live

objectui branch `claude/issue-11068-keyboard-navigation-17-6` (head `cc755a8d2`):
- `@object-ui/components`' data-table gains a roving-tabindex WAI-ARIA grid (arrows, Home/End, Ctrl+Home/End, focus return after an edit);
- `ObjectGrid` relays `schema.keyboardNavigation ?? inlineEditable`;
- the Studio registry publishes the key with its reader.

## The fix (after Restart-when)

- Drop the marker from the describe, and state the behaviour and the default that ship. The default is on when the grid renders editable; a read-only grid keeps Tab unless the key is `true`.
- Correct the row docblock's "NO read point" sentence, citing the objectui commit that reads it.
- Add one changeset (doc-only describe text; pick the level by the repo's policy).

`Clause-②: no`: the accept set does not move.

## Related

objectui#11068 · objectui#11531 · objectstack#20694 (the 17.6.0 `object-grid` row) · objectui#11227.
